**Morgantown Station** is a train station in The Forest region of Appalachia.

Situated on the outskirts of Morgantown, the facility consists of a track-side platform and station building. The location is situated along the Red Line, providing ancillary services such as a staffed ticket sales counter and automated ticket machines before the Great War. A part of the long-defunct network of train stations across Appalachia, it was re-appropriated by the Responders and set up as a hub for operations and trade via vendor bot. [Pub 1] 

The station is outfitted with a Stash Box, Punch Card Machine, and Chemistry Station. The bathroom contains three rolls of toilet paper and a plunger. There is a Legendary Exchange Machine, Ammunition Vending Machine, and Medical Supplies Vending Machine on the platform outside. In the parking lot behind the station are a Donations Box and a tent next to two rusted out vehicles, the latter containg three mattresses and two suitcases.

Plan: Chemistry Workbench - Can be found near the chemistry station inside the station building, on the ground.

As of the *Locked & Loaded* update, a Punch Card Machine was added to all train stations.

Morgantown Station appears in *Fallout 76*.
